name: Digital Daesung Co., Ltd.
summary: Digital Daesung Co., Ltd. provides online and offline educational services in South Korea and internationally. The company operates an online lecture site that offers various learning content to high school students. It also engages in the franchise business; and provision of elementary to higher education services. In addition, the company operates a Daesung Academy; and acts as an advertising agency. Further, it is involved in education and reading content services. The company was formerly known as Daesung Mimac Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Digital Daesung Co., Ltd. in December 2010. Digital Daesung Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
